title: Microsoft Teams Rooms and shared devices: passwordless sign-in for Entra resource accounts
summary: Hold: marking an account as a resource does not by itself remove access to shared files and recordings. Microsoft's updated guidance requires a separate SharePoint Online setting for that restriction. The migration paths, permissions, prerequisites and roadmap facts are supported; the checklist also names manual password-reset controls missing from the table.
